subject: Privacy & Digital Rights
title: The Chelsea Manning Leaks
description: A quick win: understand The Chelsea Manning Leaks.

hook.text: A young Army analyst leaked 750,000 classified military documents to WikiLeaks — the largest military leak ever.

buildup.text: Chelsea Manning saw evidence of civilian casualties in Iraq and Afghanistan that the public didn't know about.

discovery.text: The 'Collateral Murder' video showed a US helicopter killing civilians and journalists in Baghdad.

twist.text: Manning was sentenced to 35 years in prison. President Obama commuted her sentence after 7 years.

climax.text: Manning's leaks forced America to confront what its military did in secret — at enormous personal cost.

punchline.text: She showed the truth. She paid with her freedom.

quiz.question: What did Chelsea Manning's leaks primarily reveal?
options: Classified military documents showing unreported civilian casualties
